images.madeBy: Alex Smith, for this bestax port
images.method: Drawn by code: docs/scripts/template-art/scenes/login.mjs places every block and shape, and the voxel renderer in docs/scripts/template-art writes the SVG, with every texture generated from a palette and a seed. No photograph, stock image or other third-party image was used as an input or as a tracing reference.
images.depicts: A blocky sea at sunset: a square sun half set on the horizon at the left, a sailboat, and a striped lighthouse on a rocky island at the right with its beam lit; the page's full-screen background.
images.replaces: public/media/background.webp, the original's background photo, whose source the original does not record.
